title: The normalized ringed tensor chain equals the constructible tensor chain
statement: For prime l and finite E/Q_l, let d be normalized ringed models [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. For every scheme W, the chain (d.tensor W).chain equals ConstructibleTensorModel.tensorCompletionChain of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-chain].

proof.text: The ringed tensor canonical field gives the pure-tensor product coordinates and the zero shifted coordinate.
The constructible tensor chain component is tensorCompletionUnitMap, the actual tensor operation unit. Its coordinate normalization gives the same two coordinates.
Apply uniqueness of the strict augmentation with these two coordinates.
